assumed_layer1_chip_schema.file: artifacts/layer1/**/*.npz, one chip per file, or stacked with a leading chip axis and a 'chip' array

optional.s2: float (6,H,W) reflectance B2 B3 B4 B8 B11 B12
optional.paddy: float or uint8 (H,W) paddy mask or probability

maps/<chip>.npz.encoding: uint8, value/250 = probability, 255 = no call (outside domain)

arrays.p_sub_ge_{3,7,10,14}d: SEMI-SYNTHETIC P(submerged >= d days) x paddy
arrays.crop_loss_intolerant: SEMI-SYNTHETIC expected plant loss share, intolerant rice x P(flooded paddy)
arrays.label: int8 hand label passed through (1 water, 0 not, -1 unlabelled)
arrays.domain: uint8 1 where a call is made (labelled, not permanent water)

outputs.chips.parquet: one row per chip: split, pixel counts, expected / label / baseline flooded-paddy pixels, bounds (lon/lat) if known
outputs.models.json: fusion weights, calibrator, pixel-model selection, duration model
outputs.metrics.json: val and test tables, gaps, per-event test, area check, semi-synthetic duration check
